holdout.exit_rich_rule: Choose half the optional coordinates using SeedSequence([seed, optional_assets, 920]); set those targets to zero and rescale the remaining optional targets to their original total mass. Recompute only their target corridors. Current holdings, hard bounds, group rows, cash bounds, mandatory declarations, tickets and tolerances remain unchanged. Tiny controls retain positive targets.

specification.fault_case_rule: First declared case in each of ETF, legacy synthetic and fresh holdout. Inject only after all timed comparisons, restore the primary callable immediately, and run the genuine V2 fallback. Do not pool injected outcomes with natural fallback rates or timing.
specification.timing: Serial single-thread numerical libraries. Rotate V2, MIQP and Policy order by case. V2-started calls follow and include V2 generation cost. Legacy 60/600-second budget calls alternate budget order. Every MIQP call is fresh; no cross-arm incumbent is supplied except the explicitly named V2 start. Preparation is charged to each arm. Native and wrapper allowances are not hard wall-clock guarantees.
specification.freeze: Verify released wheel and all ETF checksums, serialize every synthetic input and record all numerical source hashes before the first solve. Resume only with matching frozen source and input hashes. No algorithm, grid, objective, constraint or tolerance tuning after observing results.
specification.scope: Public supplied-input ETF decisions and generated numerical portfolios only. Same-model conditional decisions, not own-book rolling returns, independent external validation or a global optimality proof. Factorial variants share random draws. Failed preparation and failed arms remain in denominators.

legacy_design.domain: Identical prepared CORRIDOR states; full joint refers to simultaneous state and size optimization, not an expanded FULL domain.
legacy_design.generator: Unchanged public breadth generator: heterogeneous positive holdings, two forced exits, correlated factor covariance with positive residuals, sector and optional overlapping fractional groups. The larger dimension retains the same minimum trade and holding thresholds. No private data.
legacy_design.timing: Serial calls with one native thread. V2 runs once. Reverse budget order on odd cases and alternate common-base/V2-started order within budgets. Each call is fresh; no incumbent passes between budgets. Preparation is included in every E2E cost; V2 generation is charged to each V2-started call. Native work may overrun an allowance.
legacy_design.certificates: Native statuses and MIP bounds are diagnostics. Existing plain/perspective supporting-plane LP dual bounds with residual correction supply separate conservative numerical bounds. Independent exhaustive full-weight QPs on two tiny cases retain unresolved supports. No primal relaxation is reported as a bound.
legacy_design.decision_rule: Report every outcome with no search, policy or tolerance tuning. This prospective synthetic grid is not independent external market validation or an own-holdings return study. No speed advantage is assumed.
